flagged.evidence: The locator says “the Chevalley–Eilenberg zero-cochain differential formula, printed p. 239 (PDF p. 23).” In [Weibel §7.7](https://math.mit.edu/~hrm/palestine/weibel/07-lie_algebra_homology_and_cohomology.pdf), p. 239 contains Definition 7.7.1 for the chain differential; the cochain complex and coboundary are presented under Corollary 7.7.3 on p. 241 (PDF p. 25). Thus p. 239 does not locate the cited cochain formula, though the local formula is supplied by [F1].
